top_signals.title: Nasdaq 100 Slumps Most Since June as Bonds Rally: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: A rout in technology giants and escalating Middle East hostilities sent stocks lower, pushing investors toward the safety of bonds.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: College Hurt by International Student Drop to Drain Endowment
top_signals.summary: The Illinois Institute of Technology, a STEM focused university in Chicago, plans to borrow as much as $200 million from its endowment through fiscal 2028 as it struggles with a decline in international students.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Indian tech company eMudhra announces withdrawal from certificate business after security incident
top_signals.summary: The issue was publicized by cybersecurity researcher Scott Helme, who published a blog saying that instead of a random 384-bit number, one of the company's private keys was just the number four.
